parameters.query:
-- Threshold and repeat interval come from the Ledger's settings
-- (core.stale_job_alert_hours, default 4 h, decisions item 24; editable in the console).
-- The argument is how often this workflow runs, in minutes.
SELECT oldest_pending_job_id, oldest_pending_job_type, oldest_pending_age_min, pending_count,
       paused_pending_count, newest_heartbeat_age_min, threshold_hours
  FROM api.queue_health(15)
 WHERE should_alert;

parameters.text: =:hourglass_flowing_sand: queue stale (over {{ $json.threshold_hours }} h) | oldest job {{ $json.oldest_pending_job_id }} | type {{ $json.oldest_pending_job_type }} | waiting {{ $json.oldest_pending_age_min }} min | pending {{ $json.pending_count }} | paused {{ $json.paused_pending_count }} | last worker heartbeat {{ $json.newest_heartbeat_age_min ?? 'never' }} min ago
